name: HYDROCORTISONE 500MG/5ML INJECTABLE SOLUTION 1 AMPOULE
description: Hydrocortisone injectable solution 500 mg/5 ml is a potent corticosteroid indicated for the treatment of serious disorders such as shock, severe allergic reactions, acute asthma exacerbations, and other inflammatory or immunosuppressive conditions. It is administered intravenously or intramuscularly and only under medical supervision. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
